correctness.rationale: The exact forbidden-triangle face predicate separates 0,1,2 central-clique vertices and yields A=join of graph one-skeleta, B=join of discrete outer sets, central cones on B and isolated central edges. A is (2n-2)-connected while B has dimension n-1, so B→A is null, and B→S0*B is null by a cone. The homotopy pushout yields a high sphere wedge plus s suspensions of B; central edges add binom(s,2) free circles. Integral augmentation lattice V_i, wedge^2 V_i and join-Kunneth yield the three natural homology representations; degree shifts provide correct signs on outer-block exchange. Rational group invariants vanish for full internal symmetric groups, only rational (not integral) acyclicity claimed. Direct independent bitset boundary ranks matched three cases (s;q)=(2;3,3),(3;3,3,3),(3;3,4). All quantified parameters are supported by structural proof, not just finite tests.
